en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside cityscape labeled "Dresden." The image shows grand baroque and historicist buildings along a river, with multiple towers and spires, and a large stone bridge crossing the water. River steamers and boats travel on the river, while a grassy bank with timber in the foreground frames the scene. The sky is pale blue with a few white clouds.
